Bug_Details: Duration.from(Duration) returns itself; from(Period) throws a runtime exception. Duration.from(TemporalAmount) will always throw a UnsupportedTemporalTypeException when passed a Period and return itself when passed a Duration.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the lines where Duration.from() is called with a Period or a TemporalAmount that is a Period. This will throw an UnsupportedTemporalTypeException at runtime.
Trigger_Explanation: The test cases trigger the bug by calling methods that internally call Duration.from() with a Period or TemporalAmount that is a Period, which throws an UnsupportedTemporalTypeException.
